shortDescription: Crypto liquidations totaled $128 million in the past hour. According to Odaily, CoinGlass data showed $125 million in short liquidations and $3.47 million in long liquidations; Bitcoin liquidations reached $98.37 million, while Ether liquidations totaled $18.87 million.

title: Crypto Liquidations Total $128 Million in Past Hour, Mostly Shorts
